full_prompt_en: A square graphic urban illustration shows a stern-looking man standing in the left foreground beside the front of a dark car. He faces partly toward the viewer with his head slightly lowered and one hand near a pocket, while the other arm hangs at his side. Short dark hair, heavy brows, a shadowed jaw, and an open brown jacket give him a rugged appearance. A pale blue shirt shows beneath the jacket, and dark trousers continue off the bottom edge. The car stretches across the lower center and right. Its angular hood and rectangular grille are drawn in strong black lines; two bright round headlights face outward and reflect on the glossy bodywork. Behind the car, a low street and flat-roofed buildings recede toward a cluster of tall towers on the horizon. Palm tree silhouettes punctuate the lower skyline. A high utility pole rises at the right, with many black power lines swinging diagonally across the saturated sky toward the buildings. The sky transitions from deep magenta at the top to orange and peach near the horizon, making the city towers appear in violet haze. Dark navy and plum shadows fill the street, the vehicle, and the man's jacket. Small cool cyan highlights on his shirt and face contrast with the hot sunset and red reflections along the hood. Bold contour lines, clean shadow blocks, and selective painted gradients give the image a polished game-poster character. The view is low and close, so the man and car dominate while the skyline supplies scale and atmosphere. No readable text is visible. The scene conveys a tense pause at dusk, with the headlights on and the man still against the broad glowing backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、图像感强的城市插画中，一名神情严峻的男子站在左侧前景，靠着一辆深色汽车的车头。他部分面向观者，头略低，一只手靠近口袋，另一只手垂在身侧。深色短发、浓重眉毛、带阴影的下颌和敞开的棕色外套让他显得粗粝。外套下露出浅蓝衬衫，深色裤子延伸出画面底缘。汽车横跨下方中央与右边。棱角分明的引擎盖和矩形格栅由强黑线描出；两只明亮圆形车灯朝前照亮，并在有光泽的车身上留下反射。车后，低矮街道和平顶建筑退向地平线上的一簇高楼。棕榈树剪影点缀下方天际线。右侧一根高电线杆升起，多股黑色电线斜扫过饱和天空，牵向建筑。天空从上方深洋红过渡到近地平线的橙色与桃色，使城市高楼落在紫色雾里。深海军蓝和李紫阴影填满街道、车辆与男子外套。衬衫和脸部的小块冷青高光，与炽热晚霞及引擎盖上的红色反射形成对照。粗实轮廓线、干净阴影块和选择性的绘画渐层给影像一种精致游戏海报气质。视点低且近，使男子与汽车占主导，天际线提供尺度和气氛。没有可读文字。场景像黄昏的一次紧张停顿，车灯亮着，男子在宽阔发光背景前静止。
style_prompt_en: Graphic urban illustration combines strong ink-like outlines, simplified shadow masses, and saturated dusk color gradients. Deep magenta and orange sky bands glow behind violet silhouettes, while the foreground holds glossy black, plum, and navy forms with narrow cyan highlights. Diagonal utility wires and upright poles create a dense linear web over broad color fields. A low near viewpoint gives large angular shapes immediate weight; small distant towers and palms establish depth without fine architectural detail. Round bright light sources punctuate dark geometry and reflect along hard edges. The finish is clean but painterly within the color areas, with the tense polish of a contemporary action poster.
style_prompt_zh: 图像化城市插画把强烈墨线轮廓、概括的阴影大块和饱和黄昏渐层结合起来。深洋红与橙色天空带在紫色剪影后发亮，前景承载光泽黑色、李紫和海军蓝形体，并有狭窄冷青高光。斜向电线与竖立杆柱在宽阔色面上织出密集线网。低而近的视点让大型棱角形体有直接重量，小型远处高楼和棕榈建立深度，无须精细建筑细节。圆形亮光点破深暗几何，并沿硬边产生反射。表面整洁，但色面内部仍有绘画感，带当代动作海报式的紧张光泽。
theme_en: A stern man leaning beside a car beneath a magenta city sunset
theme_zh: 男子在洋红落日的城市街边倚车而立
name: Grand Theft Auto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
